scope: Bounded public customer/Admin full-gift whole original undelivered refund, exact paid completion and fixed refund/invoice runtime contracts

contracts.entry: Existing customer refundApply/refundVerify and both Admin refund creation prefixes; immutable actor/key/review/quote and execution receipts preserved. No route, UI or client-controlled materialization flag added.
contracts.activation: Trusted public-entry server policy plus strict persisted full-gift source selects v2 inside the order lock; ordinary public applications retain v1. Generic, automatic and broad explicit-server contracts remain separate; old v1 full-gift claims cannot upgrade on execution or replay.
contracts.admission: Original pid=0/type=0/status=0 paid whole order only, positive full paid amount, yue/weixin/alipay, customer type1 or authorized Admin type4, at most100 lines, exact whole purchase and gift quantities, SKU, coupon-instance provenance and source gift points. Partial quantities, reduced Admin cash, splits, delivery, type2 return or gift-only remainder refuse.
contracts.paidCompletion: Exactly one order.paid:{id}, order aggregate identity, exact two-field orderId/orderNo payload and COMPLETED terminal state required even for physical-gift-only campaigns. Read-only outbox lookup preserves worker outbox-to-order lock order; quote/create/provider admission/finalizer recheck.
contracts.runtimeCatalog: Eight canonical invoice/refund components with exact fingerprint, safety and same-owner checks plus current LOGIN SELECT/UPDATE/append privileges, PG16 public/read-committed/origin environment and no enabled event triggers. Missing/drifted catalog or permissions returns503 before a claim or quote; no DDL/grant/repair or v1 fallback.
contracts.settlement: Whole receipt keeps original order/cart entities and atomically returns purchased/gift stock, cash and available source gift points; immutable receipt failure rolls back all local state. Paid coupon instances, paid labels and paid campaign/coupon pools retained under the legacy PHP boundary.
contracts.release: Customer cancellation and Admin refusal release exact quantity reservations independently of newly added financial admission. No paid-pool return or late reward grant.
contracts.recovery: Persisted original provider refund identifier and known SUCCESS survive local finalizer failure; fresh service resumes local settlement without another provider request/query. Terminal notify-time projection is allowed; cash, stock, points, coupons, labels and paid pools remain idempotent. Provider results are mocked in this local proof.
contracts.compatibility: Ordinary customer/Admin refund, immutable quote and create/execute recovery, v1 quantity reservations, cross-session contention and lookup receipts remain covered. No broader physical partial/split refund activation.
